summary: Retest of deployment fix: backend/.env presence and parseability, backend startup + /api/health, environment-driven CORS, and public preview URL health. Backend pytest suite (5 tests) re-run clean. 2 relevant pre-existing browser checks re-ran by name with no regression. Public URL https://deploy-hub-247.preview.emergentagent.com/api/health confirmed returning 200 {status:'ok'}. No new criteria required new artifacts beyond backend inspection since all 4 matrix items are already covered by existing backend tests + curl evidence + browser checks.
